Registration name: JACable
Exhibition name: Spice Twice ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, before 1992).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1997 as 'Spice Twice'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend. Strong, spice fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 6". Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
